    Lemma 12.6: mesh normal forms with the same support #

    deformation-refinements.tex (lem:same-support-forms). Let C(λ) be the mesh normal forms kQ/(𝔪^{N+1}, r_v − Σ_i λ_i (p_i)_v) of Proposition 12.2, with the residual paths p_i, each internal to its own periodic component. If λ_i = 0 exactly when λ'_i = 0, then C(λ) ≅ C(λ') by an object-preserving isomorphism.

    The proof is the source's. Choose a_i ∈ kˣ; prescribe μ_a = a_i on the internal arrows of the ith residual component and the row scale a_i² on its vertices, scale one on the other periodic components. The mate map σ on arrows has chains and cycles; its cycles lie in the periodic part (σ² translates both endpoints), so the scale equations μ_{σa} μ_a = η_v (eq:global-mesh-scales) can be solved successively along every chain, with no closing condition (exists_chain_solution). The diagonal map sends r_v ↦ η_v r_v and p_i ↦ a_i^{d_i} p_i, so it changes λ_i to λ_i a_i^{d_i-2}; take a_i a root of λ'_i/λ_i.

    Generalizations: any characteristic, any mesh coefficients (the same on both sides), any finite translation quiver; the residual rows are any rows of length at least three, internal to pairwise distinct periodic components.
